set.n: Missing $1,028 from an 1898 roadside shooting, road to Holy Hill
set.pl: Woods about ½ mi up the old Hartford-Holy Hill road from the farmhouse in sec. 35 T10N R18E (c.1915 Hixson plat), about halfway out (about 4 mi from Hartford)
set.st: Late May 1898: on the road back from Holy Hill, about 4 mi from Hartford, a man shot his companion, emptied his money bag (sworn at $1,028 in gold, silver, paper and change), dragged him down a slope and drove on to Hartford. He was arrested that night with $5.75; the bag and revolver were never found. Private farmland: permission. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: The money left in the buggy; if hidden, it lies along the Holy Hill road between the shooting spot and Hartford. 1937 aerial: the likeliest woods are the wooded creek valley running SW-NE through secs 34-35 toward Pike Lake, just west of the farm, about 1/4 to 3/4 mi back up the road. Record only.
